annotation.title_clean: New report and guidelines for indigenous data sovereignty in artificial intelligence developments
annotation.title_en: New report and guidelines for indigenous data sovereignty in artificial intelligence developments
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO news item announcing the report "Indigenous People-Centered AI: Perspectives from Latin America and the Caribbean", which calls for participatory inclusion of Indigenous communities, Indigenous data sovereignty, free, prior and informed consent, and public policies covering every phase of AI development. It describes five Mexican best practices. Robots and physical AI are not covered.
key_provisions_or_claims: Urges participatory inclusion of Indigenous communities in all phases of AI development
Indigenous data digitisation must respect self-determination, data governance rights and free, prior and informed consent
Protect Indigenous privacy and intellectual property, and counter misappropriation of cultural patterns
Proposes public policies to integrate Indigenous perspectives into AI
Highlights five Mexican best practices in Indigenous-language AI
